entities.summary: Anna Petrovna Ostroumova-Lebedeva was a Russian draughtsman and painter during the Modernist period, most notable for her watercolor painting. She was also one of the pioneers of the woodcut technique in Russia. She was one of the members of the art association "The Four Arts", which existed in Moscow and Leningrad from 1924 to 1931.
